info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

In generally excellent condition from our exterior-only observations. There is a visible roof patch which suggests some interior damage may be present. Parcel has been in the same family since 1945. A square 40, roughly 1320' x 1320'. We did not find any improved road to this parcel, and title documents do not infer that there is an easement for access through the parcels between it and M-134 to the south. You may need to negotiate access rights with a neighbor. We note that there IS a parcel for sale between this property and the road which woul...

parcels.address: E Old Ferry Drive, Drummond Island
parcels.desc: One acre parcel less than a mile from the ferry landing on Drummond Island ! Parcel measures ~132' (E>W) x 330' (N>S), and is located near Black Rock Point. Paved county road. There is a utility easement at roadside where you'll find power and phone. This is an uplands parcel densely wooded in evergreen.

Irregular shaped parcel that is just over 10 acres in size. Runs ~1320' feet deep from the road. There is an old mobile here that has been sided in slab wood. Several piles of rubbish in the yard. Steel outbuilding with wood shed adjacent that is in rough shape. Foundation near the NE corner of parcel, and a mobile home site along the north line with uncertain septic. The mobile is generally solid...
Parcel is ~208' x 208' (one acre) in size. Located behind (north of) 9462 W Thompson Road. Has no known legal access or road frontage. Swampy and likely unbuildable.

This is a small triangular parcel that is essentially a shallow, wet ravine. It is too small to build on, and likely has little use to anyone other than an adjacent property owner. It fronts 55' on the road, then to a point, 220 feet +/- to the north.

Vacant parcel on the Munuscong River! ~50' on the road x ~400' deep, with ~60 ft of river frontage. Partially clear with some mature pine trees present. We think it is possible that the septic system (or at least part of it) for the house to the west of this parcel may actually be located on this parcel, possible encroachment issues. Unsure if property is buildable as it sits, please check with th...

Parcel fronts ~173' on N Whitefish Point Road, and runs about 125' feet deep on average. Gently rolling, wooded dry land with sandy soils. On a year-round paved county road just a couple miles north of Paradise.

parcels.desc: Two story wood frame home on a lot with a shared driveway in the Soo. Very limited offstreet parking. The roof is missing a lot of shingle, and some of the vinyl siding is missing. Inside, the house is debris strewn. It is difficult to assess its condition until it is emptied. You might be able to pay for a lot of the repairs with the returnable cans and bottles inside. parcels.desc: Two story wood frame home on Easterday Avenue just south of downtown. This is a generally solid older classic home that has been allowed to fall into serious grunge status. It has been posted as unfit for habitation by code officials, and you may wish to consult with them as to the requirements for occupancy. The exterior is overgrown, and shows signs of deferred maintenance. Upon opening the back...

Older two story wood frame home in Central Soo. Two bedrooms and a bath up. Half bath on main floor. This one is structurally sound, but difficult to fully assess because of the amount of debris. Some unpainted original trim. Foundation looks good overall with one sealed crack at the SE corner. There is some ceiling damage on the upper floor, however the roof is newer so it may be old damage. parcels.address: W 12 Mile Road, Sault Ste Marie
parcels.desc: This parcel has been in the same ownership since 1930, and was titled to a long-defunct "School District 23" and may have contained a one-room school at one time. Taint nothin' here now but brush. Parcel is ~99' feet (E-W, along 12 Mile Road) x ~214.5' feet (N-S).. The land is open, level and dry, with a few mature trees near the center.

parcels.address: S Fish Hatchery Rd @ W Company Street
parcels.desc: Parcel is ~1/4 acre, and may not be large enough for construction if Eckerman is subject to zoning ordinances. There is a small shed and an inoperable vehicle parked here. Located at the intersection of S Fish Hatchery Road and W Company Street

Parcel is 4.25 acres +/- in size., and has ~400+ feet along the east side of S Mackinac Trail, just south of the post office at Kinross. The land is level and wooded. We noticed some pockets of mucky soils, but it is overall firm and walkable. There is a circle drive from the county road that passes thru this property near the center, and we found a few piles of rubbish, including a few tires. The...

This is a 4 bedroom, 1 bath, tri-level half-of-a-duplex at the former Kincheloe AFB community halfway between the bridge and the Soo, just east of I-75. This is one dirty girl.
